item.title: Virginia Supreme Court rules U.S. Marine’s adoption of an Afghan war orphan will stand
item.description: The Virginia Supreme Court ruled Thursday that a U.S. Marine and his wife will keep an Afghan orphan they brought home in defiance of a U.S. government decision to reunite her with her Afghan family. The decision likely ends a bitter, yearslong legal battle over the girl's fate.

item.title: Russia fires barrage at Ukrainian cities as next round of US-brokered talks is unclear
item.description: KYIV, Ukraine (AP) — Russia launched a barrage of ballistic missiles and drones at Ukrainian cities in overnight attacks, officials reported on Thursday as Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Moscow was “hesitating” about another round of U.S.-brokered talks on stopping the fighting.

item.description: An all-time great comeback and a controversial exclusion were the dominant stories at the Milan Cortina Olympics on Day 6.

item.description: Alyssa Farah Griffin, the former Trump staffer-turned-co-host of "The View," is now a mom.

item.title: Holiday, Clingan boost Blazers to 135-119 win over Jazz
item.description: Jrue Holiday scored a season-high 31 points and Donovan Clingan added 23 points and 18 rebounds as the Portland Trail Blazers beat Utah 135-119.

item.title: 4A Bi-district Girls Basketball: Skyview hits the ground running in dominant playoff opener against Bethel
item.description: The Skyview girls basketball team flew somewhat under the radar on its way to a second-place finish behind top seed Union in the 4A Greater St. Helens League. After a dominant performance to open the Class 4A bi-district playoffs Thursday, the Storm may no longer have the luxury of anonymity.

item.title: Boys Basketball Roundup: Jamison McCann scores 40 points to lead Ridgefield into 2A district tournament
item.description: Jamison McCann scored 40 points as Ridgefield boys basketball beat Aberdeen 95-65 in a Class 2A District 4 play-in game on Thursday.

item.title: Girls Basketball Roundup: Brooklynn Haywood moves into No. 5 on state career scoring list in Union win
item.description: Brooklynn Haywood moved into fifth place in the state’s career scoring ranks as Union girls basketball beat Kentwood 83-52 in the first round of the District 3-4 tournament on Thursday.
